overview.description: The International Vegan Climate ETF (VEGX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks an index of international large- and mid-cap stocks of companies aligned with vegan and climate-conscious principles. Portfolio holdings are weighted by market-cap. VEGX was launched on Sep 10, 2026 and is issued by Beyond Investing.
